caption: Preview both bodies and source links.
eval: const p = app.plugins.plugins['pdf-quote-join']; for (const m of [...p.modals]) m.close(); p.pro.signOut(); const v = app.workspace.activeEditor; const e = v.editor; const d = e.getValue(); const start = d.indexOf('> [!'); const end = d.indexOf('\n\n## Next step'); e.setSelection(e.offsetToPos(start), e.offsetToPos(end)); p.previewSelection(e,v); 'ok'

caption: Find eligible adjacent pairs with Pro.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['pdf-quote-join']; for (const m of [...p.modals]) m.close(); p.pro.opts.http = async () => ({ status: 200, json: { data: { viewer: { login: 'demo-reader' }, user: { sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor: { isActive: true, isOneTimePayment: false, tier: { name: '$5 a month', monthlyPriceInCents: 500 } } } } } }); app.secretStorage.setSecret('pdf-quote-join-github-token', 'gho_' + '0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow(); const v = app.workspace.activeEditor; if (v.editor.getValue().split('> [!pdf').length !== 3) throw new Error('Expected two original callouts'); p.scan(v.editor,v); if (!document.querySelector('.pdf-quote-join-pair-preview')) throw new Error('Expected an eligible pair'); return 'ok'; })()
